disposition_reason: Tables 2 to 4 print trace element means for raw and experimentally brine-canned chub mackerel after high-pressure processing and frozen storage.

study.design: controlled processing experiment: high-pressure processing (0-600 MPa), freezing, frozen storage and canning
study.origin: Atlantic chub mackerel (Scomber colias) caught near the Galician Atlantic coast, acquired at Vigo harbour, Spain
study.qa: DORM-2 CRM: Cd 0.038 vs 0.043, Pb 0.047 vs 0.065, As 17.3 vs 18.0 mg/kg measured vs certified
